text_en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,
text_cn: 耶稣讲完了这一切话，便对他的门徒说：

text_en: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified. ”
text_cn: “你们知道：两天以后就是逾越节，人子要被解送，被钉在十字架上。”

text_en: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people gathered in the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
text_cn: 那时，司祭长和民间长老，都聚集在名叫盖法的大司祭的庭院内，

text_en: and they conspired to arrest Jesus by stealth and kill him.
text_cn: 共同议决要用诡计捉拿耶稣，加以杀害。

text_en: But they said, “Not during the festival, or there may be a riot among the people. ”
text_cn: 但是他们说：“不可在庆节期内，免得民间发生暴动。”

text_en: Now while Jesus was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,
text_cn: 耶稣正在伯达尼癞病人西满家里时，

text_en: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very costly ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.
text_cn: 有一个女人拿着一玉瓶贵重的香液来到耶稣跟前，倒在正坐席的耶稣的头上。

text_en: But when the disciples saw it, they were angry and said, “Why this waste?
text_cn: 门徒们见了就不满意说： “为什么这样浪费？

text_en: For this ointment could have been sold for a large sum, and the money given to the poor. ”
text_cn: 这香液原可卖得许多钱，施舍给穷人。”

text_en: But Jesus, aware of this, said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has performed a good service for me.
text_cn: 耶稣知道了，就对他们说：“你们为什么叫这个女人难受？她在我身上原是作了一件善事。

text_en: For you always have the poor with you, but you will not always have me.
text_cn: 你们常有穷人同你们在一起，至于我，你们却不常有。

text_en: By pouring this ointment on my body she has prepared me for burial.
text_cn: 她把这香液倒在我身上，原是为安葬我而作的。

text_en: Truly I tell you, wherever this good news is proclaimed in the whole world, what she has done will be told in remembrance of her. ”
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：将来在全世界，这福音无论传到哪里，必要述说她所作的事，来纪念她。”

text_en: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
text_cn: 随后，那十二人中之一，名叫犹达斯依斯加略的，去见司祭长，

text_en: and said, “What will you give me if I betray him to you? ” They paid him thirty pieces of silver.
text_cn: 说：“我把他交给你们，你们愿意给我什么？”他们约定给他三十块银钱。

text_en: And from that moment he began to look for an opportunity to betray him.
text_cn: 从此他便寻找机会，要把耶稣交出。

text_en: On the first day of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Where do you want us to make the preparations for you to eat the Passover? ”
text_cn: 无酵节的第一天，门徒前来对耶稣说：“你愿意我们在哪里，给你预备吃逾越节晚餐？”

text_en: He said, “Go into the city to a certain man, and say to him, ‘The Teacher says, My time is near; I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“你们进城去见某人，对他说：师傅说：我的时候近了，我要与我的门徒在你那里举行逾越节。”

text_en: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them, and they prepared the Passover meal.
text_cn: 门徒就照耶稣吩咐他们的作了，预备了逾越节晚餐。

text_en: When it was evening, he took his place with the twelve;
text_cn: 到了晚上，耶稣与十二门徒坐席。

text_en: and while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me. ”
text_cn: 他们正吃晚餐的时候，耶稣说：“我实在告诉你们：你们中有一个人要出卖我。”

text_en: And they became greatly distressed and began to say to him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord? ”
text_cn: 他们非常忧闷，开始各自对他说：“主，难道是我吗？”

text_en: He answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“那同我一起把手蘸在盘子里的人，要出卖我。

text_en: The Son of Man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that one by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that one not to have been born. ”
text_cn: 人子固然要按照指着他所记载的而去，但出卖人子的那人却是有祸的！那人若没有生，为他更好。”

text_en: Judas, who betrayed him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi? ” He replied, “You have said so. ”
text_cn: 那要出卖他的犹达斯也开口问耶稣说：“辣彼，难道是我吗？”耶稣对他说：“你说的是。”

text_en: While they were eating, Jesus took a loaf of bread, and after blessing it he broke it, gave it to the disciples, and said, “Take, eat; this is my body. ”
text_cn: 他们正吃晚餐的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福了，擘开递给门徒说：“你们拿去吃吧！这是我的身体。”

text_en: Then he took a cup, and after giving thanks he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you;
text_cn: 然后，又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们说：“你们都由其中喝吧！

text_en: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
text_cn: 因为这是我的血，新约的血，为大众倾流，以赦免罪过。

text_en: I tell you, I will never again drink of this fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁了直到在我父的国里那一天，与你们同喝新酒。”

text_en: When they had sung the hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
text_cn: 他们唱了圣咏，就出来往橄榄山去。

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “You will all become deserters because of me this night; for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered. ’
text_cn: 那时，耶稣对他们说：“今夜你们都要为我的缘故跌倒，因为经上记载：‘我要打击牧人，羊群就要四散。’

text_en: But after I am raised up, I will go ahead of you to Galilee. ”
text_cn: 但是，我复活后，要在你们以先到加里肋亚去。”

text_en: Peter said to him, “Though all become deserters because of you, I will never desert you. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄却回答他说：“即便众人都为你的缘故跌倒，我决不会跌倒。”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, this very night, before the cock crows, you will deny me three times. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“我实在告诉你：今夜鸡叫以前，你要三次不认我。”

text_en: Peter said to him, “Even though I must die with you, I will not deny you. ” And so said all the disciples.
text_cn: 伯多禄对他说：“即便我该同你一起死，我也决不会不认你。”众门徒也都这样说了。

text_en: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane; and he said to his disciples, “Sit here while I go over there and pray. ”
text_cn: 随后，耶稣同他们来到一个名叫革责玛尼的庄园里，便对门徒说：“你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祈祷。”

text_en: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be grieved and agitated.
text_cn: 遂带了伯多禄和载伯德的两个儿子同去，开始忧闷恐怖起来，

text_en: Then he said to them, “I am deeply grieved, even to death; remain here, and stay awake with me. ”
text_cn: 对他们说：“我的心灵忧闷得要死，你们留在这里同我一起醒寤吧！”

text_en: And going a little farther, he threw himself on the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me; yet not what I want but what you want. ”
text_cn: 他稍微前行，就俯首至地祈祷说：“我父！若是可能，就让这杯离开我吧！但不要照我，而要照你所愿意的。”

text_en: Then he came to the disciples and found them sleeping; and he said to Peter, “So, could you not stay awake with me one hour?
text_cn: 他来到门徒那里，见他们睡着了，便对伯多禄说：“你们竟不能同我醒寤一个时辰吗？

text_en: Stay awake and pray that you may not come into the time of trial; the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. ”
text_cn: 醒寤祈祷罢！免陷于诱惑；心神固然切愿，但肉体却软弱。”

text_en: Again he went away for the second time and prayed, “My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it, your will be done. ”
text_cn: 他第二次再去祈祷说：“我父！如果这杯不能离去，非要我喝不可，就成就你的意愿吧！”

text_en: Again he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
text_cn: 他又回来，见他们仍然睡着，因为他们的眼睛很是沉重。

text_en: So leaving them again, he went away and prayed for the third time, saying the same words.
text_cn: 他再离开他们，第三次去祈祷，又说了同样的话。

text_en: Then he came to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and taking your rest? See, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text_cn: 然后回到门徒那里，对他们说：“你们睡下去吧！休息吧！看，时候到了，人子就要被交于罪人手里。

text_en: Get up, let us be going. See, my betrayer is at hand. ”
text_cn: 起来，我们去吧！看，那出卖我的已来近了。”

text_en: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, arrived; with him was a large crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
text_cn: 他还在说话的时候，看！那十二人中之一的犹达斯来了；同他一起的，还有许多带着刀剑棍棒的群众，是由司祭长和民间的长老派来的。

text_en: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, “The one I will kiss is the man; arrest him. ”
text_cn: 那出卖耶稣的给了他们一个暗号说：“我口亲谁，谁就是，你们拿住他。”

text_en: At once he came up to Jesus and said, “Greetings, Rabbi! ” and kissed him.
text_cn: 犹达斯一来到耶稣跟前，就说：“辣彼，你好！”就口亲了他。

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Friend, do what you are here to do. ” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and arrested him.
text_cn: 耶稣却对他说：“朋友，你来做的事就做吧！”于是他们上前，向耶稣下手，拿住了他。

text_en: Suddenly, one of those with Jesus put his hand on his sword, drew it, and struck the slave of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
text_cn: 有同耶稣在一起的一个人， 伸手拔出自己的剑，砍了大司祭的仆人一剑削去了他的一个耳朵。

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place; for all who take the sword will perish by the sword.
text_cn: 耶稣遂对他说：“把你的剑放回原处，因为凡持剑的，必死在剑下。

text_en: Do you think that I cannot appeal to my Father, and he will at once send me more than twelve legions of angels?
text_cn: 你想我不能要求我父，即刻给我调动十二军以上的天使吗？

text_en: But how then would the scriptures be fulfilled, which say it must happen in this way? ”
text_cn: 若这样，怎能应验经上所载应如此成就的事呢？”

text_en: At that hour Jesus said to the crowds, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest me as though I were a bandit? Day after day I sat in the temple teaching, and you did not arrest me.
text_cn: 在那时，耶稣对群众说：“你们带着刀剑棍棒出来拿我，如同对付强盗。我天天坐在圣殿内施教，你们没有拿我。”

text_en: But all this has taken place, so that the scriptures of the prophets may be fulfilled. ” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.
text_cn: 这一切都发生了，是为应验先知所记载的。于是门徒都撇下他逃跑了。

text_en: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, in whose house the scribes and the elders had gathered.
text_cn: 那些拿住耶稣的人，将耶稣带到大司祭盖法前；经师和长老已聚集在那里。

text_en: But Peter was following him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest; and going inside, he sat with the guards in order to see how this would end.
text_cn: 伯多禄远远跟着耶稣，直到大司祭的庭院，他也进到里面，坐在差役中观看结局。

text_en: Now the chief priests and the whole council were looking for false testimony against Jesus so that they might put him to death,
text_cn: 司祭长和全公议会寻找相反耶稣的假证据，要把他处死。

text_en: but they found none, though many false witnesses came forward. At last two came forward
text_cn: 虽然有许多假见证出庭，但没有找出什么。最后有两个人上前来，

text_en: and said, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and to build it in three days. ’”
text_cn: 说：“这人曾经说过：我能拆毁天主的圣殿，在三天内我能把它重建起来。”

text_en: The high priest stood up and said, “Have you no answer? What is it that they testify against you? ”
text_cn: 大司祭就站起来，对他说：“这些人作证反对你的事，你什么也不回答吗？”

text_en: But Jesus was silent. Then the high priest said to him, “I put you under oath before the living God, tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却不出声。于是大司祭对他说：“我因生活的天主，起誓命你告诉我们：你是不是默西亚，天主之子？”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. But I tell you, From now on you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你说的是。并且，我告诉你们：从此你们将要看见人子坐在大能者的右边，乘着天上的云彩降来。”

text_en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He has blasphemed! Why do we still need witnesses? You have now heard his blasphemy.
text_cn: 大司祭遂撕裂自己的衣服说：“他说了亵渎的话。何必还需要见证呢？你们刚才听到了这亵渎的话，

text_en: What is your verdict? ” They answered, “He deserves death. ”
text_cn: 你们以为该怎样？”他们回答说：“他该死。”

text_en: Then they spat in his face and struck him; and some slapped him,
text_cn: 众人遂即向他脸上吐唾沫，用拳头打他；另有一些人也用巴掌打他，

text_en: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Messiah! Who is it that struck you? ”
text_cn: 说：“默西亚，你猜猜是谁打你？”

text_en: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant-girl came to him and said, “You also were with Jesus the Galilean. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄在外面庭院里坐着，有一个使女来到他跟前说：“你也是同那加里肋亚人耶稣一起的。”

text_en: But he denied it before all of them, saying, “I do not know what you are talking about. ”
text_cn: 他当着众人否认说：“我不知道你说的是什么。”

text_en: When he went out to the porch, another servant-girl saw him, and she said to the bystanders, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth. ”
text_cn: 他出去到了门廊，另有一个使女看见他，就对那里的人说：“这人是同那纳匝肋人耶稣一起的。”

text_en: Again he denied it with an oath, “I do not know the man. ”
text_cn: 他又发誓否认说：“我不认识这个人。”

text_en: After a little while the bystanders came up and said to Peter, “Certainly you are also one of them, for your accent betrays you. ”
text_cn: 过了一会，站在那里的人前来对伯多禄说：“的确，你也是他们中的一个，因为你的口音把你露出来了。”

text_en: Then he began to curse, and he swore an oath, “I do not know the man! ” At that moment the cock crowed.
text_cn: 伯多禄就开始诅咒发誓说：“我不认识这个人。”立时鸡就叫了。

text_en: Then Peter remembered what Jesus had said: “Before the cock crows, you will deny me three times. ” And he went out and wept bitterly.
text_cn: 伯多禄便想起耶稣所说的话来：“鸡叫以前，你要三次不认我。”他一到了外面，就伤心痛哭起来。
